mapper.select: SELECT n.*, u.nickname AS publisher_name FROM sys_notice n LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = n.publisher AND u.is_deleted = 0 WHERE n.is_deleted = 0 AND n.id = #{id} AND n.tenant_id = #{tenantId}

SELECT n.id, n.title, n.type, n.content, n.level, n.is_top, u.nickname AS publisher_name, n.publish_time, CASE WHEN r.id IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS is_read, r.read_time FROM sys_notice n LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = n.publisher AND u.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_notice_read r ON r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.notice_id = n.id AND r.user_id = #{userId} WHERE ORDER BY n.is_top DESC, n.sort ASC, n.publish_time DESC, n.create_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_notice n LEFT JOIN sys_notice_read r ON r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.notice_id = n.id AND r.user_id = #{userId} WHERE AND r.id IS NULL
SELECT n.id FROM sys_notice n LEFT JOIN sys_notice_read r ON r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.notice_id = n.id AND r.user_id = #{userId} WHERE AND r.id IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_notice n WHERE AND n.id = #{id}
